about: age, the small program that locks mail keys away, pinned to one release and one archive per kind of computer. mc-mail-age.js downloads the archive for this computer the first time a key is kept or opened, refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches the line below, and keeps age and age-keygen in ~/.godspeed/mail/age. It never upgrades it by itself and never touches an age the person installed; an installed age is used first. Until 8 October 2026 nothing on a computer install fetched age, so the first `mc-mail connect agentmail` stopped and asked the person to install it.
